req.title: Echo request headers
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /headers with a JSON object whose 'headers' field mirrors the request headers received.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /headers must return a JSON object with a 'headers' field that mirrors the request headers. I design tests covering: (1) positive EP — standard custom header is echoed exactly; (2) positive EP — multiple custom headers all echoed; (3) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method returns 405; (4) BVA — single-character header value echoed exactly; (5) BVA — header with maximum typical length echoed; (6) DT — Host header always present in echo; (7) EP — Content-Type header echoed when sent. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_headers_echo_custom_header_exact_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /headers with custom header X-Test-Header: hello-world
trace: R-HTTPBIN-012: response 'headers' field mirrors request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_headers_echo_custom_header_exact_value():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/headers', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'hello-world'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'headers' in data
    headers = data['headers']
    assert isinstance(headers, dict)
    assert headers.get('X-Test-Header') == 'hello-world'

test_headers_echo_custom_header_exact_value()
